ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Disregard the assessment notations listed above. The graduate tuition rate for this section is $362 per credit hour; the undergraduate tuition rate is $325 per credit hour. All students in this section will also be assessed a $50 per credit hour administration fee. These per credit hour assessments are not included in campus range assessments. Lecture videos, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through CITES Wiki. Students are expected to take course exams and complete online assignments on ACE Organic as outlined in the syllabus. Students must report to campus or to an approved off-site testing center for all exams. Discussion sessions will be conducted online using Elluminate Live! at the indicated times. Participation in the live discussion session is recommended; discussions will also be recorded and archived online. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees. The ProctorU rates are $22.50 for 2 hours and $8.75 for each additional hour.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
